stem: Aiko is selling books for $12 each. She wants to make more than $180 in book sales. The inequality 12b > 180 can be used to determine the number of books, b, she must sell in order to meet her goal. Which number line best represents the solution to the inequality?

options.label: A
options.text: (Number line with closed dot at 15 and arrow to the right) 0, 10, 20

options.label: B
options.text: (Number line with closed dot at 15 and arrow to the left) 0, 10, 20

options.label: C
options.text: (Number line with open circle at 15 and arrow to the right) 0, 10, 20

options.label: D
options.text: (Number line with open circle at 15 and arrow to the left) 0, 10, 20

visual_elements: Four number lines labeled A, B, C, D with number points at 0, 10, 15, 20; A and B have closed dots at 15, C and D have open circles at 15; A and C have arrows pointing right; B and D have arrows pointing left.
